observations.behavior: Adds concurrency test asserting HogQL query scheduling behavior across multiple scenes.

observations.behavior: Updates production concurrency controller selection to include AnalyticsProductHome alongside SavedInsights for HogQL query throttling.
observations.posthog_connection: Applies HogQL-specific concurrency protection to both SavedInsights and AnalyticsProductHome views, potentially reducing database load during high-concurrency scenarios.

observations.behavior: Imports scene-dependent state management into concurrency tests; P1.F1 also adds HogQLQueryResponse type import.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes dependency on scene context required by updated concurrency checks, though this alone is not evidence of tier elevation.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks provided. No release notes or adoption metrics available. Tier assignment relies solely on these code changes without broader system impact assessment.

review.limitations: Only three hunks provided. No release notes or adoption metrics available. Tier assignment relies solely on these code changes without broader system impact assessment.
review.reason: Changes are substantive: they extend a bounded correctness improvement—HogQL query scheduling and its associated test coverage—to an additional view while retaining implementation and relevant checks in the diff. This does not demonstrate systemic risk reduction across components sufficient for tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's HogQL execution layer and shared concurrency controls used when users run queries in either Saved Insights or Product Home analytics contexts. Could help prevent resource contention but no production benefit is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: Assessment limited to supplied chunk; full change group may include other dependencies or configuration updates that could raise or lower tier.
